title: FOUND OBJECT FRAMES
description: Homes can now frame odd little keepsakes from races, harvests, dungeon wipes, and pet errands, with optional mats, shelf lights, and labels written in the player's own notes.
consequence: The shelf starts charging rent to memories.

title: QUEST-WORN KEEPSAKES
description: Old tools, charms, and camp objects now keep visible wear from the moments they survived, making repaired gear feel worth keeping instead of replacing at the next vendor.
consequence: The old axe stops looking temporary.

title: PREMIUM MEMORY STAMPS
description: Scrapbooks now offer paid stamp packs for harvest days, pet birthdays, first catches, and village festivals, letting every memory arrive with a cleaner decorative category.
consequence: The memory starts checking the sticker drawer.

title: AUTOFILLED TROPHY CASE
description: Run trophies now arrange themselves automatically by rarity, date, and build type, replacing the old messy shelf where players chose which strange victories mattered.
consequence: The trophy case gets efficient and forgettable.
